applicant.name: Mag. Petra Lang
applicant.organisation: RehaPlus Kliniken GmbH, admissions management (private rehabilitation provider)

purpose: Our admissions team will use the records for routine case management, to decide which stroke patients with poorly controlled blood pressure are offered a rehabilitation place first and which are placed on the waiting list.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and systolic blood pressure values for adults with ischaemic stroke who have at least one systolic blood pressure value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Ischaemic stroke = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I63.
Cohort = adults with ischaemic stroke who have at least one systolic blood pressure value (LOINC 8480-6).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The stated purpose amounts to decisions detrimental to natural persons (Art. 54(a)). Access is refused (Art. 54); a refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)).

judge.why: Rule 1: using records to decide which stroke patients get a rehabilitation place first and which go on a waiting list is a detrimental decision about individuals under Art. 54.
